name: North Dakota
agency: North Dakota Department of Transportation (NDDOT), Driver License Division
permitAge: 14 (instruction permit; parent or guardian sponsorship under 18) (handbook p. 3)

teen.supervisedHours: 50 hours of supervised practice driving for applicants under 16, signed off by a parent (handbook p. 3); no hour count stated for 16-17
teen.holdPermit: Age 14-15: 12 months or until 16, whichever comes first, but at least 6 months. Age 16-17: 6 months or until 18, whichever comes first (handbook p. 3)
teen.nightLimit: Age 15 restricted license: no driving between the later of sunset or 9 p.m. and 5 a.m. without a parent, guardian or person 18+, except directly to/from work, official school activity or religious activity; restricted license becomes unrestricted at 16 (handbook p. 6)
teen.phone: Permit holders of any age and licensed drivers under 18: no electronic communication device while driving (p. 6). All drivers: texting banned, $100 fine (p. 30).

notes: Handbook: Noncommercial Driver License Manual, Class D, cover '2025-2027', pages marked 'Revised 2025', form DL0126 (PDF created 2026-01-14). Checked 2026-10-09; printed page = PDF page minus 4.
Exam size and pass mark (25 questions, 80 percent = 20) come from third-party practice sites only; neither the handbook nor the NDDOT driver pages checked 2026-10-09 state them.

Class D knowledge test languages (handbook p. 1): English, Arabic, Spanish, Somali, Russian, Vietnamese, Turkish, Swahili, Nepali, Serbo-Croatian, French, Pashto, Dari, Chinese; ASL and audio testing at 8 offices. Online test at nd.knowtodrive.com.
Permit supervisor: valid license for the vehicle class, at least 18, at least 3 years driving experience, in the seat beside the permit holder (p. 3).
Restricted license at 15 after road test; may drive only vehicles of a parent, guardian, grandparent, sibling, aunt or uncle (p. 6). Driver education required under 16 (p. 2, 6).

Move over (p. 32, NDCC 39-10-26.3): stranded vehicle with hazard lights on interstate or multi-lane highway outside city limits: move to a non-adjacent lane if safe, else slow down. Emergency/NDDOT vehicles on multi-lane roads: move over (p. 20).
School bus (p. 20): both directions stop for flashing red lights. Separate-roadway exception is in NDCC 39-10-46(5), not in the handbook.
Spanish manual (2023 edition, older than the English one) linked from https://dot.nd.gov/node/5501.
